events.verdict: Ferguson (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Holiday (NOP).
From RHH, George (OKC) appears to make little or no to Randle's (NOP) arm as he reaches for the rebound, and he does not affect his ability to secure the ball.
Randle (NOP) and George (OKC) engage to establish position before the rebound.

From available angles, it appears that Westbrook (OKC) makes clean contact with Randle's (NOP) hand while it is in contact with the ball on the block. After the ball is dislodged, the additional contact is incidental.
Okafor (NOP) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Ferguson (OKC) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Adams (OKC) and Williams (NOP) reach for the rebound, Adams making incidental contact that does not affect Williams ability to get to the ball.
Ferguson (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position on Holiday (NOP) during the drive.
Adams (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position during the play at the basket by Randle (NOP).
Williams (NOP) and George (OKC) engage and separate on the slipped pick.
Holiday (NOP) makes contact to the body of Westbrook (OKC) during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Randle (NOP) takes fewer than three steps after he has gathered the ball.
Westbrook (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Randle (NOP).
Adams (OKC) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Williams (NOP) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Adams (OKC) makes marginal contact to Okafor (NOP) after he has passed the ball that does not affect his FOM.
Adams (OKC) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Randle (NOP) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
RLS shows Randle (NOP) makes incidental contact to the arm of Westbrook (OKC) as both players go for the loose ball and the contact does not affect Westbrook's ability to get the ball.
Okafor (NOP) leans into Westbrook (OKC) under the rim as Westbrook disengages to chase the rebound.

RAR and LAR show Randle (NOP) places a forearm to Westbrook's (OKC) side as he gathers the ball, but before he has started his upward shooting motion. Randle withdraws his arm as Westbrook steps away from the contact and starts his shot.
Williams (NOP) and Ferguson (OKC) make incidental contact as part of their legal attempts to get to the rebound.
Ferguson (OKC) commits a take foul on Randle (NOP).
Adams (OKC) never establishes himself in a legal screening position and delivers contact to Holiday (NOP) affecting his ability to defend on the play.
Felton (OKC) commits a take foul on Holiday (NOP).
Okafor (NOP) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by George (OKC).
Felton (OKC) cleanly dislodges the ball from Miller (NOP) as he grabs the rebound.
Ferguson (OKC) commits a take foul on Randle (NOP).
Adams (OKC) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Holiday (NOP) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
